## Checklist

- [ ] `downloadURLs` points straight at the file (.zip, .rez or .ndat). Opening it downloads the file; it doesn't show a web page, ask for a login or captcha, or make you click through.
- [ ] The link goes to the author's original download. I haven't uploaded the plug-in anywhere myself.
- [ ] If I did host anything here (icon or screenshots), the author said that's fine. Link or quote below.
- [ ] The plug-in contains no EV Nova base data, and the icon and screenshots contain no art from the original game that we don't have permission to share.
- [ ] `id` is lowercase with dashes and doesn't clash with another entry.
- [ ] `sizeBytes` is filled in (and `sha256` if you can).
- [ ] Ran `python3 scripts/validate.py --urls` and it passed.
